svg.title: vulkan-moe-streaming
svg.desc: Run Mixture-of-Experts models bigger than your RAM on a gaming PC with an AMD or any Vulkan GPU. 1.9 times faster answers and 7 times faster prompt reading than stock llama.cpp.
svg.text: A llama.cpp patch that streams experts from your NVMe into RAM and VRAM —
built for AMD Radeon and any other Vulkan GPU.
